context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG FIX VERIFIED: The 'Objects are not valid as React child' error is fixed. Root cause was: (1) Frontend was sending {occupant_id, occupant_name} but backend RoomAssign model expects {registration_id}. Fixed in AdminRoomManagement.js line ~174 and AdminGuestList.js line ~354. (2) Error handlers were passing Pydantic validation error objects directly to toast.error() - fixed by checking `typeof detail === 'string'` before passing to toast. All room assignment flows now work correctly. MOCKED: Bulk Guest Messaging send functionality (UI scaffold only, no actual SMS/WhatsApp delivery).

mocked_apis.Bulk Guest Messaging: UI scaffold only - message compose works but no actual SMS/WhatsApp delivery

bug_fix_verification.bug_description: Room assignment throws 'Objects are not valid as React child' error
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Frontend sending wrong payload format {occupant_id, occupant_name} instead of {registration_id}, and error handlers passing Pydantic validation objects to toast.error()
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Changed payload to {registration_id: guest.id} and added typeof check for error messages
